extracted.name: Chocolate Wafer Crust
extracted.description: This simple and delicious crust of chocolate wafers and butter is perfect for your favorite cheesecake recipe, or for a strawberry and whipped cream pie.
instruction_lines: Mix crumbs and melted butter or margarine until well blended. Press into an 8 or 9 inch pie plate. Chill until firm.
